@@U03745@@
(Approaching, a man in chains at his side.)

@@U03746@@
In place of the solemn greeting that is your due,
in place of reverential welcome,
I bring you this man,
fast-bound in chains,
this servant who, failing at his duty,
made me fail at mine.
Kneel, 林叩斯,
before this most exalted of women
and confess to your guilt!
This, great Queen,
is a man of rare and keen sight.
I appointed him myself
to observe from the lookout tower
the full expanse of earth and sky,
and to report any movement
within the circle of our hills and valley,
any approach on the fortress,
whether of herds, which we protect,
or armies, which we do not.
But today, what a calamity!
You arrive, and he fails to report!
Making us derelict in our duty
properly to honor a guest of such noble worth.
His life is herewith forfeit,
and he would already have paid with his own death,
except that it is for you, and you alone,
to punish or pardon, as you see fit.

@@U03748@@
You honor me with the dignity of both
judge and ruler—and even if it is only
to test me, as I must assume,
I will exercise the judge's high duty
of hearing the accused.
You may speak.
translation:
@@U03745@@
（走近，他身边有一个戴着铁链的男人。）

@@U03746@@
代替你应有的庄严问候，
代替虔诚的欢迎，
我给你带来这个人，
被锁链快速束缚，
这个仆人没有尽到自己的职责，
让我失败了。
跪下，林叩斯，
在这位最尊贵的女性之前
并承认你的罪行！
这位伟大的女王，
是一位罕见而敏锐的目光的人。
我亲自指定他
从了望塔观察
广阔的大地和天空，
并报告任何活动
在我们的山丘和山谷的圈子里，
任何接近堡垒的方法，
无论是我们保护的牛群，
或军队，但我们没有。
但今天，真是一场灾难！
你到了，他却没有报告！
使我们失职
适当地招待一位如此高贵的客人。
他的生命就此丧失，
他已经付出了自己的死亡的代价，
除了它是为了你，而且是为了你一个人，
按照您认为合适的方式惩罚或赦免。

@@U03748@@
你以双方的尊严来尊重我
法官和统治者——即使只是
来测试我，正如我必须假设的那样，
我将履行法官的崇高职责
听取被告的陈述。
你可以说话。
